title: Enhancing Navigation Safety for Sustainable Inland Water Transport: A Case Study of Sarawak, Malaysia
content:
Navigation safety along inland waterways is imperative to reduce accidents and prevent loss of human life, economic loss and negative environmental impact. To enhance navigation safety and ensure sustainability of Sarawak's inland water transport, this study proposes development of suitable navigation technologies, better training and effective emergency response system.


ABSTRACT

Inland water transport (IWT) plays a key role in facilitating economic growth and environmental sustainability in Sarawak, Malaysia. Navigation safety remains a significant concern as incidents and accidents can result in loss of human life, economic loss, and a negative environmental impact. This study aims to propose enhancements to navigation safety for sustainable IWT in Sarawak by identifying the key challenges to achieve safety and sustainability and proposing suitable recommendations to address the identified problems. It also highlights the factors contributing to navigation hazards, particularly artificial obstacles, human factors, and inadequate aids to navigation (AtoN). This research employs a quantitative method, utilising data collection through online survey, content analysis of relevant statutes, literature review on related topics, and data obtained from relevant agencies. The findings indicate that artificial obstacles were identified as the leading navigation hazard (36.4%), followed by human factors (19.6%), while navigation planning and safety emerged as the most frequently recommended infrastructure-risk mitigation measure (29.9%). The solutions put forward include the development of advanced navigation technologies, better training and effective emergency response systems. It is hoped that the results obtained from this study will help to improve the safety of navigation, the practice of sustainable IWT and general development of IWT in Sarawak. It can also be used on other inland waters having similar properties.
